chunks.summary: POI catalog for Île de la Cité and Île St. Louis — Notre-Dame, Sainte-Chapelle, Conciergerie, Deportation Memorial, riverside promenades.
POI catalog around the Louvre, Orsay, Orangerie, Tuileries, Palais Royal courtyards.
POI catalog around the Eiffel Tower, Trocadéro, Quai Branly, Sewer Museum, Army Museum/Napoleon's Tomb, Rodin, Marmottan.
POI catalog for the Latin Quarter, Cluny, St. Sulpice, Luxembourg, Panthéon, Montparnasse.
POI catalog around the Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Petit/Grand Palais, Opéra Garnier, Galeries Lafayette, La Défense.
POI catalog for the Marais (Pompidou, Picasso, Place des Vosges, Carnavalet, Père Lachaise) and Montmartre (Sacré-Cœur, Pigalle).
Walking tour from Notre-Dame through Île de la Cité to Sainte-Chapelle, Conciergerie, Pont Neuf, with Left Bank detour.
Self-guided tour of the Louvre — Greek antiquities, Italian Renaissance, French paintings, Near Eastern antiquities.
Self-guided tour of the Orsay — Realism, Impressionism, Post-Impressionism, Belle Epoque decorative arts.
Self-guided tour of the Orangerie — Monet's Water Lilies plus the Walter-Guillaume Collection.
Walking tour of the Rue Cler market street — Parisian shop life, vendors, cheesemongers, charcuteries.
Self-guided tour of the Eiffel Tower — construction history, the three levels, engineering facts, views.
Self-guided tour of the Rodin Museum — The Thinker, Gates of Hell, Burghers of Calais, The Kiss, garden sculptures.
Self-guided tour of the Musée de l'Armée and Dôme church — Napoleon's tomb, WWI and WWII galleries, Louis XIV to Napoleon exhibits.
Self-guided bus tour along line 69 — Eiffel Tower to Père Lachaise, crossing the Seine twice with commentary on sights along the route.
Self-guided tour of the Marmottan — Monet's late water-lily paintings, Berthe Morisot, medieval illuminations.
Walking tour through the Latin Quarter and St-Germain — Sorbonne, St-Séverin, Shakespeare and Company, Café de Flore, Luxembourg Garden.
Self-guided tour of the Cluny (Musée National du Moyen Âge) — Lady and the Unicorn tapestries, Roman baths, medieval sculpture.
Walking tour down the Champs-Élysées from Arc de Triomphe to Place de la Concorde — retail history, grand buildings, Tuileries approach.
Walking tour through the Marais — Place des Vosges, Hôtel de Sully, Jewish quarter, Rue des Rosiers, Carnavalet approach.
Self-guided tour of the Pompidou Center's modern/contemporary art collection — Matisse, Picasso, Kandinsky, Duchamp, mid-century onward.
Self-guided tour of Père Lachaise — Rossini, Chopin, Bizet, Proust, Oscar Wilde, Jim Morrison, Edith Piaf, Communards' Wall.
Walking tour of Montmartre — Sacré-Cœur, Place du Tertre, artist studios, Moulin de la Galette, Bateau-Lavoir, Pigalle.
Guide to Versailles — the Château (State Apartments, Hall of Mirrors), the Gardens, the Trianon palaces, the Queen's Hamlet.

chunks.section_title: Day Trip: More Grand Châteaux (Vaux-le-Vicomte, Fontainebleau, Chantilly)
chunks.summary: Combined guide to three châteaux — Vaux-le-Vicomte (Louis XIV's inspiration for Versailles), Fontainebleau (royal hunting château), Chantilly (Renaissance château and horse museum).
Guide to Chartres — the Gothic cathedral, the self-guided cathedral tour (stained glass, labyrinth, choir screen), the old town walk.
Guide to Monet's Giverny (house, gardens, water-lily pond) and Van Gogh's Auvers-sur-Oise (final days, church, wheat fields, grave).
Historical overview of France from Celts and Romans through the Revolution, Napoleon, and the 20th century.
